newsitem.title: USA: Safety-Kleen CEO resigns, company weighing options.
newsitem.headline: Safety-Kleen CEO resigns, company weighing options.

text.p: Safety-Kleen Corp said Friday John Johnson Jr. resigned as president and chief executive officer and said it is exploring strategic options to enhance shareholder value.
Safety-Kleen said Donald Brinckman, chairman of the board, was named chief executive officer. Brinckman had been chief executive officer from 1968 until December 31, 1994.
Safety-Kleen also named Joseph Chalhoub, senior vice president of operations, as president and chief operating officer. Chalhoub has been with Safety-Kleen since June 1987.
No reason for Johnson's resignation was given. The company was not immediately available for comment.
Safety-Kleen said its board has hired William Blair & Co to act as its advisor as it explores strategic options. It did not specify what the options include.
Safety-Kleen is an environmental and industrial service company that helps businesses recycle and process waste streams.
